title: Scope and responsibility
summary: The Rules apply to vessels on the high seas and connected navigable waters, while responsibility still includes precautions required by ordinary seamanship and special circumstances.
conditions: Rule 1 establishes where the regulations apply.
Rule 2 preserves responsibility for compliance, ordinary seamanship and special circumstances.

events.text: Rule 1 establishes where the regulations apply.

assumptions: Positions, timings, angles and separation are illustrative teaching choices, not rule-defined thresholds.
Motion is simplified and does not model hydrodynamics, stopping distance, current or sea state.
Vessel models and displayed lengths are scaled for legibility while preserving clearance between hulls.
Apply the COLREGs to the full circumstances; this scene is not an unconditional manoeuvring prescription.
